## **Helper Function and Variables**

**SplitTableBySampleMetadataColumn()**

Given:

- OriginalTable: a table with rows as features and columns as samples
- Metadata: sample metadata (with the first column with sample names corresponding to the names in the table)
- MetColumn: the name of a metadata column to be used for grouping

return a list of tables splitted by the metadata column values.

```{r}
SplitTableBySampleMetadataColumn <- function(OriginalTable, Metadata, MetColumn) {
  # merge (transposed) table and metadata
  df <- merge(Metadata,as.data.frame(t(OriginalTable)), by.x = 1, by.y = "row.names")
  # split in a list based on MetColumn values
  df_split <- split.data.frame(df,df[[MetColumn]])
  # remove metadata from the dfs, re-transpose
  df_split2<-df_split
  for (i in 1:length(df_split2)) {
    dd<-df_split2[[i]]
    dd_num<-dd[,c(1,(ncol(Metadata)+1):ncol(dd))]
    dd_num2<-t(dd_num[,-1])
    colnames(dd_num2)<-dd[,1]
    df_split2[[i]]<-as.matrix(dd_num2)
  }
  return(df_split2)
}
```

**SplitTableByFeatureMetadataColumn()**

Given:

- OriginalTable: a table with rows as features and columns as samples
- Metadata: feature metadata (with the first column with feature names corresponding to the rownames of the table)
- MetColumn: the name of a metadata column to be used for grouping

return a list of abundance tables splitted by the metadata column values.
  
```{r}

SplitTableByFeatureMetadataColumn <- function(OriginalTable, Metadata, MetColumn) {
  # merge (transposed) table and metadata
  df <- merge(Metadata,as.data.frame(OriginalTable), by.x = 1, by.y = "row.names")
  # split in a list based on MetColumn values
  df_split <- split.data.frame(df,df[[MetColumn]])
  # remove metadata from the dfs
  df_split2<-df_split
  for (i in 1:length(df_split2)) {
    dd<-df_split2[[i]]
    dd_num<-dd[,c(1,(ncol(Metadata)+1):ncol(dd))]
    dd_num2<-dd_num[,-1]
    row.names(dd_num2)<-dd[,1]
    if (ncol(dd_num2)>1 & nrow(dd_num2)>1) {
      df_split2[[i]]<-as.matrix(dd_num2)
    } else {
      print(paste0("Failed for ",names(df_split2)[[i]]))
      df_split2[[i]]<-NA}
  }
  return(df_split2)
}
```

**MakeBinary()**

Given a list of tables with abundance data, return a list of presence-absence tables.

```{r}
MakeBinary <- function(OriginalList) {
  dat<-OriginalList
  for (i in 1:length(dat)) {
    dd<-dat[[i]]
    dd[dd>0] <- 1
    dat[[i]] <- dd
  }
  return(dat)
}
```

Helper variables.

```{r}
Names_Taxa<-c("p__Rotifera", "p__Tardigrada", "p__Nematozoa", "p__Arthropoda", "p__Annelida")
#Names_Taxa2<-c("p__Tardigrada", "p__Nematozoa", "p__Arthropoda", "p__Annelida")
Names_Guilds<-c("Detritivores","Carnivores","Fungivores","Herbivores","Microbiovores","Omnivores","Bacterivores" )
```


## **Make tables split by taxonomy and by guild**

**Table split by taxonomy (phylum level)**
```{r}
# split by taxa
Table_SplitByTaxa <- SplitTableByFeatureMetadataColumn(tab, tmtd, "TaxGroup")
# keep only phylum used in the paper
Table_SplitByTaxa <- Table_SplitByTaxa[names(Table_SplitByTaxa) %in% Names_Taxa]
# make binary
Table_SplitByTaxa_01 <- MakeBinary(Table_SplitByTaxa)
```


**Table split by guild**

```{r}
tbl<-tab[row.names(tab) %in% fmtd$Feature.ID,]
# split by guild
Table_SplitByGuild <- SplitTableByFeatureMetadataColumn(tbl, fmtd, "guild")
# make binary
Table_SplitByGuild_01 <- MakeBinary(Table_SplitByGuild)

```



## **FIGURE 1**

### **Figure 1A**

Taxonomy barplot

```{r}
### Data preparation
# data on number of ASVs/reads per group
taxDF <- data.frame(
  Taxa = c(sub("^p__", "", names(Table_SplitByTaxa)), 
           "Others"),
  ASVs = c(sapply(Table_SplitByTaxa, nrow),
           nrow(tab) - sum(sapply(Table_SplitByTaxa, nrow))),
  Reads = c(sapply(Table_SplitByTaxa, sum),
            sum(tab) - sum(sapply(Table_SplitByTaxa, sum))))
# rename Nematozoa to Nematoda
taxDF$Taxa[taxDF$Taxa == "Nematozoa"] <- "Nematoda"
# clean and reorder names
row.names(taxDF)<-NULL
taxDF$Taxa<-factor(taxDF$Taxa, levels = c("Annelida","Arthropoda","Nematoda","Rotifera","Tardigrada","Others"))

### Fig 1A - number of ASVs
t1<-ggplot(taxDF, aes(x = "", y = ASVs, fill = Taxa)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Number of ASVs") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_si(""))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_blank())

### Fig 1A - number of reads
t2<-ggplot(taxDF, aes(x = "", y = Reads, fill = Taxa)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Number of reads") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,5000000,10000000,15000000), labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_si(""))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_blank())
```

### **Figure 1C**

Taxonomy curves

```{r}
# tbl_01 <- Table_SplitByTaxa_01
# res <- iNEXT(tbl_01, q=c(0,2), datatype = "incidence_raw",
#             endpoint = 800, knots = 80,
#             se = TRUE, conf = 0.95, nboot = 500)
# saveRDS(res,"RDSs/iNEXT_FullTable_ByTaxa.rds")
iNEXT_FullTable_ByTaxa <- readRDS("RDSs/iNEXT_FullTable_ByTaxa.rds")

t3<-ggiNEXT(iNEXT_FullTable_ByTaxa, type = 1,
        facet.var = "Order.q", color.var = "Assemblage",
        se = TRUE, grey = FALSE) +
  xlab("Number of samples") + ylab("") +
  facet_wrap(~Order.q, scales="free",
             labeller = labeller(
               Order.q = c("0" = "Richness","2" = "1/Simpson"))) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = rep(16,5)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


### **Figure 1D**

Taxonomy curves

```{r}
# tbl_01 <- Table_SplitByGuild_01
# res <- iNEXT(tbl_01, q=c(0,2), datatype = "incidence_raw",

# saveRDS(res,"RDSs/iNEXT_FullTable_ByGuild.rds")
iNEXT_FullTable_ByGuild <- readRDS("RDSs/iNEXT_FullTable_ByGuild.rds")
g3<-ggiNEXT(iNEXT_FullTable_ByGuild, type = 1,
        facet.var = "Order.q", color.var = "Assemblage",
        se = TRUE, grey = FALSE) +
  xlab("Number of samples") + ylab("") +
  facet_wrap(~Order.q, scales="free",
             labeller = labeller(
               Order.q = c("0" = "Richness","2" = "1/Simpson"))) +
  scale_color_hue() +
  scale_fill_hue() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = rep(16,7)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


### **Figure 1 complete**

```{r, fig.width=21*0.7, fig.height=14.8*0.7, out.width="100%"}
fig1<-ggarrange(
  ggarrange(ggarrange(t1,t2, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right"),t3, widths = c(1,1.5)),
  ggarrange(ggarrange(g1,g2, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right"),g3, widths = c(1,1.5)),
  nrow=2
)

print(fig1)

ggsave("Figures/Figure_1.pdf", plot = fig1, device="pdf",
      width = 21*1.5, height = 14.8*1.5, units = "cm", bg="white")

```

```{r}
                 Order.q = c("0" = "Richness","2" = "1/Simpson"))) +
```
```{r}
    scale_color_manual(values=c("Permanent crop"="#6A3D9A","Annual crop"="#B15928"),
                       labels=c("Annual crop","Perennial crop")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("Permanent crop"="#6A3D9A","Annual crop"="#B15928"),
                       labels=c("Annual crop","Perennial crop")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    guides(shape = "none", linetype = "none") +
```
```{r}
    ggtitle(names(dat)[i])
}

```

## **FIGURE 4**

### Data preparation

Trophic guild log-ratios were calculated using [QURRO](https://www.example.com) ([Fedarko et al., 2020](https://doi.org/10.1093/nargab/lqaa023)) by comparing the summed abundances of features assigned to different guilds. As example two comparisons are shown:

- **detritivores** + **fungivores** / **herbivores**
- **carnivores** / **herbivores** + **fungivores**

```{r}
# function to remove null log ratios and convert to numeric data type
CleanUp <- function(rat) {
  rat<-rat[!rat$Current_Natural_Log_Ratio == "null",]
  rat$Current_Natural_Log_Ratio<-as.numeric(rat$Current_Natural_Log_Ratio)
  return(rat)
}

# load metadata
met <- read.csv("LUCAS_data/LUCAS_metadata.tsv", header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors = F, check.names = F)

# load log ratios
R1 <- read.csv("LUCAS_data/Ratio_FunDet_VS_Her.tsv", header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors = F, check.names = F)
R2 <- read.csv("LUCAS_data/Ratio_Car_VS_HerFun.tsv", header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors = F, check.names = F)

# clean up
R_1 <- CleanUp(R1[,1:2])
R_2 <- CleanUp(R2[,1:2])

df_1 <- merge(R_1,met, by = "SampleID")
df_2 <- merge(R_2,met, by = "SampleID")

df_1$Antrop<-factor(df_1$Antrop, levels=c("Natural", "Antropic"))
df_2$Antrop<-factor(df_2$Antrop, levels=c("Natural", "Antropic"))

df_1$LC_simpl_2018<-factor(df_1$LC_simpl_2018,levels=c("Woodland", "Grassland", "Cropland"))
df_2$LC_simpl_2018<-factor(df_2$LC_simpl_2018,levels=c("Woodland", "Grassland", "Cropland"))

```

### **Figure 4A,B,C,D**

```{r}
f4a<-ggboxplot(df_1, x = "Antrop", y = "Current_Natural_Log_Ratio",
          color = "Antrop", palette = "jco", add = "jitter",
          title = "",
          legend = "right") + xlab("") + ylab("Natural log ratio") +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     label.x = 1.38) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Antropic"="#D55E00","Natural"="#0072B2")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

f4b<-ggboxplot(df_2, x = "Antrop", y = "Current_Natural_Log_Ratio",
          color = "Antrop", palette = "jco", add = "jitter",
          title = "",
          legend = "right") + xlab("") + ylab("Natural log ratio") +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     label.x = 1.38) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Antropic"="#D55E00","Natural"="#0072B2")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())


my_comparisons <- list( c("Woodland", "Grassland"), c("Woodland", "Cropland"), c("Grassland", "Cropland") )
f4c<-ggboxplot(df_1, x = "LC_simpl_2018", y = "Current_Natural_Log_Ratio",
          color = "LC_simpl_2018", palette = "jco", add = "jitter",
          title = "",
          legend = "right") + xlab("") + ylab("Natural log ratio") +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, method = "wilcox.test") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Cropland"="#E7298A","Grassland"="#E6AB02","Woodland"="#33A02C")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

f4d<-ggboxplot(df_2, x = "LC_simpl_2018", y = "Current_Natural_Log_Ratio",
          color = "LC_simpl_2018", palette = "jco", add = "jitter",
          title = "",
          legend = "right") + xlab("") + ylab("Natural log ratio") +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, method = "wilcox.test") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Cropland"="#E7298A","Grassland"="#E6AB02","Woodland"="#33A02C")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())


fig4_top<-ggarrange(
  ggarrange(f4a,f4b, nrow=1, legend="none"),
  ggarrange(f4c,f4d, nrow=1, legend="none"),
  nrow=2
)


```


### **Figure 4C,D**

```{r}
# 75 LUCAS samples shared an identical bulk density value (1.067405006), while no other sample shared identical values. These samples were therefore considered artifactual and removed
ddf_1<-df_1[df_1$Bulk_density!=1.067405006,]
ddf_2<-df_2[df_2$Bulk_density!=1.067405006,]
# Also 1 samples with bulk density value (4.55) more than twice the maximum of other samples is considered an outlier and removed
ddf_1<-ddf_1[ddf_1$Bulk_density<1.8,]
ddf_2<-ddf_2[ddf_2$Bulk_density<1.8,]
# Extract only woodland samples
ddf_1<-ddf_1[ddf_1$LC_simpl_2018=="Woodland",]
ddf_2<-ddf_2[ddf_2$LC_simpl_2018=="Woodland",]

f4e<-ggscatter(ddf_1, x = "Bulk_density", y = "Current_Natural_Log_Ratio",
          add = "loess",                         # Add regression line
          conf.int = TRUE,
          title = "") +
  stat_cor(label.y = 10) + 
  ylab("Natural log ratio") + xlab(expression("Bulk density (g/" * cm^3 * ")"))
f4f<-ggscatter(ddf_2, x = "Bulk_density", y = "Current_Natural_Log_Ratio",
          add = "loess",                         # Add regression line
          conf.int = TRUE,
          title = "") +
  stat_cor(label.y = 1) + 
  ylab("Natural log ratio") + xlab(expression("Bulk density (g/" * cm^3 * ")"))


fig4_bottom<-ggarrange(f4e,f4f,ncol=2, legend="none")

```

### **Figure 4 complete**

```{r, fig.width=21*0.7, fig.height=(0.8*29.7)*0.7, out.width="100%"}
fig4<-ggarrange(fig4_top,fig4_bottom,nrow=2, heights = c(2,1))

print(fig4)

ggsave("Figures/Figure_4.pdf", plot = fig4, device="pdf", 
       width = 21*1.5, height = 0.8*29.7*1.5, units = "cm", bg="white")

```

```{r, fig.width=21*0.5, fig.height=29.7*0.5, out.width="100%"}
dat <- read.table("INVGuild.tsv", header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors = F, check.names = F)
data <- dat[,c(1,4,5)]
data <- data[!is.na(data$Taxonomic_level),]
data <- data[!is.na(data$Ecology),]

desired_order <- rev(c("Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"))

data$Taxonomic_level <- factor(
  data$Taxonomic_level,
  levels = desired_order
)
level_counts <- data %>%
  count(Taxonomic_level)
x_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(level_counts$Taxonomic_level, "\n\n(",
         level_counts$n, ")"),
  level_counts$Taxonomic_level
)
sf1a<-ggplot(data, aes(x = Taxonomic_level, fill = Ecology)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "",y = "",fill = "") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
  theme_minimal() 


phyla <- c("Annelida", "Arthropoda", "Nematoda",
           "Rotifera", "Tardigrada")
data_filtered <- data %>%
  mutate(Phylum = str_extract(Taxon, "(?<=p__)[^;]+")) %>%
  filter(Phylum %in% phyla)
data_filtered$Phylum <- factor(
  data_filtered$Phylum,
  levels = phyla
)
level_counts2 <- data_filtered %>%
  count(Phylum)
x_labels2 <- setNames(
  paste0(level_counts2$Phylum, "\n\n(",
         level_counts2$n, ")"),
  level_counts2$Phylum
)
sf1b<-ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = Phylum, fill = Ecology)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels2) +
  labs(x = "",y = "",fill = "") +
  theme_minimal()

sfig1<-ggarrange(sf1a,sf1b, nrow = 2)

print(sfig1)

ggsave("Figures/Supplementary_Figure_1.pdf", plot=sfig1, device="pdf", 
       width = 21, height = 29.7, units = "cm", bg="white")
```
